objective: Al terminar usas la pasiva impersonal para informar de lo que se dice o se cree (He is said to be…, It is reported that…).

warmup.prompt_es: 'Se dice que el ministro dimitirá.' En prensa y en textos formales se oye mucho la estructura impersonal. Permite informar sin decir quién lo dice.

text: The mayor is said to be considering a run for national office. According to sources, he is believed to have met party leaders in secret last week. It is reported that talks have been taking place for months, although the mayor's office has denied this. The politician is known to dislike publicity, and he is thought to prefer working behind the scenes.

Meanwhile, the city's new bridge is expected to open in June. It was originally supposed to be ready last year, but the project is understood to have run into financial difficulties. The cost is estimated to have doubled since the start of construction. It is rumoured that the contractor has left the project, but this has not been confirmed.

Critics claim that the council is being badly managed, and some of them are alleged to have received donations from rival firms. The mayor, who is considered to be a skilled negotiator, is expected to respond at a press conference tomorrow.
input.es: Se dice que el alcalde está considerando presentarse a un cargo nacional. Según fuentes, se cree que se reunió en secreto con dirigentes del partido la semana pasada. Se informa de que las conversaciones llevan meses en marcha, aunque la oficina del alcalde lo ha negado. Se sabe que al político no le gusta la publicidad y se piensa que prefiere trabajar entre bastidores. Mientras tanto, se espera que el nuevo puente de la ciudad abra en junio. En un principio debía estar listo el año pasado, pero se entiende que el proyecto ha tenido dificultades financieras. Se calcula que el coste se ha duplicado desde el inicio de las obras. Se rumorea que el contratista ha abandonado el proyecto, pero no se ha confirmado. Los críticos afirman que el ayuntamiento está mal gestionado y se alega que algunos de ellos han recibido donaciones de empresas rivales. Se espera que el alcalde, considerado un hábil negociador, responda mañana en una rueda de prensa.

md_es: **Pasiva impersonal con verbos de opinión o información**
Verbos: *say, believe, think, know, report, expect, consider, understand, claim, allege, estimate, rumour, suppose*.
| Estructura | Forma | Ejemplo |
| **It + pasiva + that** | *It is said that he is rich.* | impersonal, formal |
| **Sujeto + pasiva + to + infinitivo** | *He is said to be rich.* | mismo tiempo |
| **Sujeto + pasiva + to have + participio** | *He is said to have been rich.* | acción **anterior** |
| **Sujeto + pasiva + to be + -ing** | *He is believed to be hiding.* | acción en curso |
**Uso de tiempos**
- *They say he is ill.* → *He is said to be ill.* (presente).
- *They say he was ill.* → *He is said to have been ill.* (pasado).
- *It was believed that he was innocent.* → *He was believed to be innocent.*
- *It is expected that prices will rise.* → *Prices are expected to rise.*
**Con 'supposed to' y 'be known as'**
- *You're supposed to arrive by nine.* (se espera / debes) · *He is known as 'The Chef'.* · *She is thought of as a leader.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *It is said him to be rich.* → ✔ *He is said to be rich.*
- ✘ *He is said that he is rich.* → ✔ *It is said that he is rich.*
- ✘ *They are believed to be win the match.* → ✔ *They are believed to win / to have won the match.*
- ✘ *It is said to be rich.* → ✔ *He is said to be rich.*
**Ojo:** *claim* y *allege* sugieren duda; *known* y *proven* indican certeza. *Allegedly* (presuntamente) protege de problemas legales: *The man, allegedly involved in the fraud, …*
Pronunciación: *alleged* /əˈledʒd/ · *rumoured* /ˈruːməd/ · *estimate* (verbo) /ˈestɪmeɪt/ vs (sustantivo) /ˈestɪmət/.
